subject: a colossal waterfall of dark ocean water thundering down a sheer rock wall into a vast dry white salt basin far below, mist exploding upward from the base, a single lone sea-stack pillar of rock at the foot of the falls dwarfed for scale, the right two-thirds filled with the immense cataract and rising spray, the left third dark and near-empty for the headline text
title: 1000x THE AMAZON
subtitle: the megaflood
